informal: Section 3: relabeling a vertex with no neighbor in U
original:
Hence, for the rest of the proof, we assume that $(a,b,c)=(s-2,s+1,s-2)$ .

Since $\overline{d}_{U}=2(s-2)/(s-1)<2$ in this case, we can find a vertex $u\in U$ that has at most one neighbor in $U$ .
Change the label of $u$ from $1$ to $2$ (so the corresponding vertex labeling $\varphi$ now takes three values $1,2$ , and $s$ ).
If $u$ has no neighbor in $U$ , then we have

 $(|E_{2}|,|E_{s+1}|,|E_{s+2}|,|E_{2s}|)=(s-2,s-2,3,s-2),$
